default_resolution: HOLD affected branch until qualified evidence is supplied

items.name: Facility and personnel
items.unknown: Named qualified fabrication and cryogenic/electrical-metrology providers, approved facility SOP revisions, operator roles and safety acceptance are not specified.

items.name: Safe robot workspace
items.unknown: Nonmagnetic/ESD-compatible carrier and tool qualification; exclusion zones, approach envelope, mass, grasps, loads, clearances and emergency support are unknown.

items.name: Material preparation release
items.unknown: Full lithographic/contact/doping/thermal history, lot and die ID, encapsulation/contamination condition, supplier certificate and release criteria are missing.

items.name: Terminal-to-channel mapping
items.unknown: Qualified package pinout, lead continuity, contact type, wiring leakage map, source/reference roles and polarity are not fully supplied.

items.name: Environmental qualification
items.unknown: Actual field calibration/homogeneity/direction, local thermometer calibration, chip thermalization, liquid/gas/pressure state and stabilization times/tolerances are unknown.

items.name: Bridge qualification
items.unknown: CCC winding assignments, calibration/history, residual balance/corrections, current-source tracking, integration/filter ranges and ratio/sign conventions are incomplete.

items.name: Cycle details
items.unknown: Exact current polarity reversal sequence, ramp/settling/dwell, rejected transients, thermal EMF removal and timestamp definitions are missing.

items.name: Condition matrix
items.unknown: Exact chronological order, acquisition counts for every field/bias condition, block IDs, reruns/exclusions and permitted ranges are not provided.

items.name: Replicate design
items.unknown: Independent die/chip/lot, cooldown, remount and interlaboratory replicate numbers, randomization and analysis power need prospective design.

items.name: Raw evidence
items.unknown: Per-reading raw ratio, uncertainty, timestamp, polarity cycle, full reference history and fault flags are unavailable.

items.name: Allan implementation
items.unknown: Input representation/units, any integration into phase-like data, overlap/indexing, treatment of irregular timestamps and relative-error conventions require resolution.

items.name: Uncertainty and covariance
items.unknown: Complete type-A/type-B budget, shared-reference covariance, stability correction and confidence/coverage rule are absent.

items.name: Reference resistors
items.unknown: Actual 100-ohm and 12.9-kiloohm asset IDs, calibrated values, bath setpoints, temperature coefficients, drift and per-device current/power limits are unknown.

items.name: High-bias external check
items.unknown: SI 4 subarray identity, actual temperature, winding ratio and actual reference-resistor current need clarification.

items.name: Stop and recovery
items.unknown: Approved current/voltage/field/temperature bounds, quench/pressure/oxygen/vacuum alarms, response roles and independent safety-state observations are missing.

items.name: Measurement acceptance
items.unknown: Prospective accuracy/stability/uncertainty targets and scientific rejection rules are not defined for a new implementation. Paper values are not pass thresholds.

items.name: Source ambiguities
items.unknown: Resolve C01–C18 where necessary with competent source/method review; do not fabricate corrective metadata.

items.name: 3D interfaces
items.unknown: Carrier/fixture/enclosure dimensions, anchored datums, unit scale, collision meshes, cable bend limits and station interface contracts remain unqualified.

items.name: Custody storage
items.unknown: Approved atmosphere/temperature/ESD storage, post-test condition checks, damaged-chip quarantine and waste ownership are not source-defined.

items.name: Current status metadata
items.unknown: Crossmark could not be read; no formal current-status certificate established.
